_comment: FREEZE_V8.json TEMPLATE — NOT YET FROZEN. All fields marked <PENDING> must be filled before any test evaluation is run. This template documents the required structure. Committing a completed version of this file constitutes the protocol freeze.
written_at: <ISO-8601 timestamp — must predate first extraction on the test split>
freeze_commit: <git SHA — must be the HEAD commit at the time this file is written and committed>
entry_policy_class_driver: <PENDING: owner decision D2 — Option 1 (function-only) or Option 2 (function + structural class driver)>

prerequisites.edit_size_redesign_D1: <PENDING: must be decided and implemented before generation>
prerequisites.fresh_programs_count: <PENDING: >= 36 minimum, >= 50 if using Option 1 with 38% eligibility>
prerequisites.tau_star_derived_on_new_dev: <PENDING: re-derive after fresh programs assigned to splits>

dataset_sha256.variants_tree_hash: <PENDING: sha256 of sorted file list + contents of variants/>

programs.test_count: <PENDING: must be genuinely fresh, never scored before freeze>

threshold.tau_star: <PENDING: derive on new dev split under output_free_v8>
threshold.note: Must NOT use test data. Must use output_free_v8 protocol, not v6/v7.

weight_fitting.note: fit_weights.py must be run on train split only; dev AUROC used for model selection

evaluation_plan.sha256: <PENDING: sha256 of EVALUATION_PLAN_V8.md at freeze time>

seeds.note: No other seeds may be tried after freeze

requirements_lock_sha256: <PENDING: sha256 of requirements-lock.txt at freeze time>

stopping_rules: If < 15 programs yield evaluated pairs on test: report exploratory
If data_integrity.py --strict nonzero: stop and fix before scoring
Exactly one test run: do not re-run after artifact exists

single_run_policy.note: make v7-test must not be re-run after MAIN_EVALUATION_v7test.json exists. If it fails midway, complete missing pairs with the frozen code revision and log the failure.

exclusion_rules.pair_level: evaluated=false if base and variant structural interfaces do not correspond, if either side raises entry error, or if data_integrity.py flags it
exclusion_rules.program_level: excluded if no eligible pairs exist under the frozen entry policy

provenance_chain: fresh_programs -> generate_v7_dataset.py (fixed SP-2) -> data_integrity.py --strict (exit 0) -> FREEZE_V8.json committed -> make v7-train -> WEIGHT_FITTING.json committed -> make v7-fit -> make v7-test (single run) -> MAIN_EVALUATION_v7test.json
